description:
Sol Mi, the girl who is single until now, is predicted to meet 3 men at once this year?! In the midst of doubts because the prediction, she got unexpected news, it turns out that she had not lived with her biological family? How is Sol Mi's family life, and her love story??

**Original Novel:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/49182994), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=2420252)
